preconditions: The stack output SyntheticInvocationState is disabled before and after every live probe window.
Every template update is reviewed as a CloudFormation change set using the dedicated service role.
The change set must have no unexpected replacement, public endpoint, public ingress, or execution-authority change.
Only generated synthetic values may be used; no customer, certificate inventory, credential, hostname, or production endpoint is authorised.
Every live probe must record request ID, UTC timestamp, expected result, actual result, and an integrity hash where applicable.

G3-C01.name: workload_identity
static_evidence: Environment variables contain no access-key variables.
Inline function source contains no embedded AWS access-key configuration.
G3-C01.live_evidence_required: Export the live function configuration and execution-role reference, then correlate one invocation request ID with the assumed workload role.
G3-C01.stop_condition: Any long-lived credential, unexpected environment variable, or role outside the reviewed stack is observed.

G3-C02.name: least_privilege_rbac
static_evidence: Operator invocation and evidence reads are MFA-gated and exact-resource scoped.
Workload permissions exclude object deletion and cryptographic lifecycle APIs.
G3-C02.live_evidence_required: Record one permitted synthetic operation and one explicitly denied out-of-scope IAM operation without widening policy to make the test convenient.
G3-C02.stop_condition: An out-of-scope operation succeeds or the test requires administrator access on the workload identity.

G3-C03.name: private_networking
static_evidence: Lambda is attached to two declared private subnets.
The security group has no ingress and permits only TCP 443 egress.
The stack creates no NAT gateway, internet gateway, public IP, or load balancer.
G3-C03.live_evidence_required: Export subnet public-IP settings, route tables, security-group rules, VPC endpoint routes, and a successful private S3 request correlation.
captured_live_evidence: Both workload subnets show No (private), no auto-assigned public IPv4 address and no auto-assigned IPv6 address.
Both private route tables contain only the local VPC route and the active S3 gateway-endpoint route; no default internet route was observed.
The S3 gateway endpoint is Available and attached to both private route tables.
The workload security group shows zero inbound entries and one outbound entry; the reviewed template defines that entry as TCP 443.
The controlled write and restore requests completed through the reviewed private workload path.
G3-C03.stop_condition: A public IP, direct internet-gateway route, public ingress rule, or unexpected egress path is observed.

G3-C04.name: encryption
static_evidence: The bucket requires TLS through an explicit aws:SecureTransport deny.
The bucket and written object use SSE-S3 encryption.
G3-C04.live_evidence_required: Export live bucket encryption and policy configuration and record an insecure-transport denial without exposing credentials.
captured_live_evidence: Live bucket properties show SSE-S3 default encryption, SSE-C blocked and versioning enabled.
Block all public access is On and the live bucket policy denies requests where aws:SecureTransport is false.
A credential-free anonymous HTTP probe returned 403 Forbidden.
The evidence lifecycle rule expires current versions and permanently deletes noncurrent versions after 30 days.
G3-C04.stop_condition: The live bucket lacks encryption, public blocking, or the TLS-only deny.

G3-C05.name: secret_management
static_evidence: docs/project/12-g3-c05-secrets-management-disposition.md records why the current synthetic workload is secretless, limits the exception to synthetic staging, and names the triggers that reactivate C05.
evidence/g3/2026-11-19-c05-not-applicable-decision.json records the explicit disposition, zero remaining synthetic controls, continuing lack of execution authority, and external-decision limitation.
The deployed workload template creates no secret, interface endpoint, credential parameter or Secrets Manager permission.
G3-C05.live_evidence_required: None while the workload remains secretless synthetic staging. Reopen C05 before introducing any credential, authenticated integration, real data or execution authority.
G3-C05.stop_condition: The workload is no longer secretless or leaves synthetic staging without C05 being reopened.

G3-C06.name: central_logging
static_evidence: The function has an explicit 30-day CloudWatch log group.
The workload role can write only its exact log group.
G3-C06.live_evidence_required: Export correlated write, restore, and rejection events and demonstrate that the workload identity cannot alter retention or delete the log group.
captured_live_evidence: Write, restore and real-data-rejection request IDs were correlated in the exact Lambda log stream.
An authoritative root review showed live retention of 1 month, matching the reviewed 30-day template setting.
The workload policy grants only CreateLogStream and PutLogEvents on the exact log group and does not grant retention changes or deletion.
G3-C06.stop_condition: Request IDs cannot be correlated, retention differs from the reviewed value, or the workload can delete or reconfigure logs.

completion_rule: Do not change a control to demonstrated until the named live evidence is captured, independently reviewed, and referenced by hash or immutable record. A not-applicable disposition is accepted only for G3-C05 in the documented secretless synthetic scope. Synthetic-staging readiness does not pass G3; a real-data pilot still requires an external accountable decision.
